name: ISO 16750-4:2023 clause 5.3.1.2 temperature cycling with specified change rate for small/lightweight DUT (Tmin to Tmax, 30 cycles, powered functional checks), operating-temperature code C (-40 C to 65 C)
plain_name: Cycle a powered car electronics module 30 times between -40 C and 65 C
description: Temperature cycling of small, lightweight automotive E/E components per IEC 60068-2-14 Test Nb with the ISO 16750-4 profile: RT to Tmin in 60 min, 90 min at Tmin, Tmin to RT in 60 min, RT to Tmax in 90 min, 110 min at Tmax, Tmax to RT in 70 min; 30 cycles; the DUT is operated (modes 3.3/4.3 and 3.4/4.4) with functional tests at the end of the Tmin and Tmax dwells. Operating-temperature code C (Tmin -40 C, Tmax 65 C) is used here.
keywords: Cycle a powered car electronics module 30 times between -40 C and 65 C

sources.citation: ISO 16750-4:2023, Road vehicles - Environmental conditions and testing for electrical and electronic equipment - Part 4: Climatic loads, 4th ed., ISO (preview pages via iTeh Standards)

requirements.rationale: Code C sets Tmin = -40 C (233.15 K) and Tmax = 65 C (338.15 K); the chamber must cover both dwell temperatures.
The DUT is electrically operated and functionally tested at the end of the Tmin and Tmax dwells, so it must be wired through the chamber.
